start_service_discovery: start service discovery for MoRIIO disaggregated serving on a given hostname and port
run_proxy_server: run the MoRIIO toy proxy server that routes requests between prefill and decode instances
send_request_to_prefill: send a request to a prefill instance with remote decode parameters for disaggregated serving
stream_decode_response: stream decode responses from a decode instance as byte chunks over HTTP
handle_request: handle incoming completions or chat completions requests via the proxy server routes
